It was time for the second day camp for young male and female bikers, which we organise with our home club MTB Trial Mraveniště. The weather was spot on and the kids rode even more than last time. Lots of riders came back to us, and it's great to see someone enjoying it so much that they come to two camps in a row.

Instructors Katarína and Matěj and carers Lucka and Lenka put their hearts into it, and you can see the youngsters appreciate it. This time we had no serious injury requiring hospital treatment, and there was time for Trial training for those who had bikes, as well as an Enduro ride on nearby trails for the oldest riders led by Vlasta.
